reconfigure.title: Update Tapo robot vacuum connection
reconfigure.description: Change the IP address or the Tapo account used for this vacuum.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Tapo robot vacuum
reauth_confirm.description: The vacuum at {host} rejected the stored credentials. Enter the email and password of the Tapo account it was set up with.

discovery_confirm.title: Tapo robot vacuum found
discovery_confirm.description: A Tapo robot vacuum answered at {host}. Enter your Tapo account to add it.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect: check the IP address and that the vacuum is on
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials: check your Tapo email and password

abort.not_tapo_vacuum: The device at this address does not answer on the robot's port

clean_rooms.name: Clean specific rooms
clean_rooms.description: Send the vacuum to clean one or more named rooms. Optional suction / water / passes apply to this run (they set the robot's current clean settings first).

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: List of room names to clean (partial match, case-insensitive).

map.name: Map
map.description: Optional map name to search in (e.g. "Downstairs"). Defaults to current map.

set_room_settings.name: Set room settings
set_room_settings.description: Per-room suction / water / passes stored on the robot (the app's custom cleaning settings). RV30 Max Plus firmware 1.3.3 rejects this; there, use clean_rooms with suction / water / passes, or a preset.

clean_zone.name: Clean zones
clean_zone.description: Clean rectangles given as [x1, y1, x2, y2] in the map's real coordinates (mm, same frame as the vacuum's position_mm attribute). Starts the robot.

run_schedule.name: Run a saved schedule now
run_schedule.description: Start the clean a Tapo-app schedule would start, right now. The vacuum has no "run schedule" call, so this replays the schedule's rooms / preset, suction, water and passes. Get the id from the Schedules sensor's attributes.

send_raw.name: Send raw command
send_raw.description: Send any device method (with params) and get the response back. While the robot is working only the methods the integration itself uses are allowed, unless Force is on.

force.name: Force
force.description: Send even while the robot is cleaning, returning or paused. Off by default: probing a working robot with unknown or setup-related methods has wiped a map set and clean history on an RV30.

get_clean_records.name: Get cleaning history
get_clean_records.description: Return the vacuum's cleaning history (newest first) plus lifetime totals. Use with "Return response" in Developer Tools or response_variable in scripts.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Only return this many most recent runs.

run_preset.name: Run a preset
run_preset.description: Start a cleaning preset saved in the Tapo app (the robot's own "customisation rules"), exactly as the app would. Switches map first if the preset is on another map.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Preset name (partial, accent-insensitive) or id. See the preset buttons.

set_map.name: Switch map
set_map.description: Make another saved map the active one (multi-floor homes). The robot relocalises.

go_to.name: Go to point
go_to.description: Drive the robot to a point given in the map's real coordinates (mm, same frame as the vacuum's position_mm attribute and tapo_rv30.clean_zone). Stop it with vacuum.stop; vacuum.return_to_base sends it home.

add_schedule.name: Add schedule
add_schedule.description: Create a cleaning schedule on the robot (same as the Tapo app's Schedules). Returns the new schedule id when called with a response.

time.name: Time
time.description: Start time, in the robot's own time zone.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days to repeat on: a list of Mon..Sun, or daily, weekdays or weekend.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Room names to clean (partial match). Leave rooms and preset empty for the whole house.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: A preset saved in the Tapo app, by name or id, instead of rooms.

map.name: Map
map.description: Map the rooms are on. Defaults to the current map.

suction.name: Suction
suction.description: Suction level for the scheduled run.

water.name: Water
water.description: Water level for the scheduled run.

passes.name: Passes
passes.description: Passes for the scheduled run, 1 to 3.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Create the schedule switched on (default) or off.

ignore_dnd.name: Ignore Do Not Disturb
ignore_dnd.description: Save the schedule even if its start time is inside the robot's Do Not Disturb window. The robot will not run it until the time or the window changes; by default the call is refused instead.

set_schedule.name: Change schedule
set_schedule.description: Change a schedule on the robot. Only the fields you give change; use the schedules sensor for the ids.

schedule_id.name: Schedule id
schedule_id.description: The robot's id for the schedule, e.g. S1.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Switch the schedule on or off.

time.name: Time
time.description: New start time, in the robot's own time zone.

days.name: Days
days.description: New days: a list of Mon..Sun, or daily, weekdays or weekend.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Room names to clean (partial match). Leave rooms and preset empty for the whole house.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: A preset saved in the Tapo app, by name or id, instead of rooms.

map.name: Map
map.description: Map the rooms are on. Defaults to the current map.

suction.name: Suction
suction.description: Suction level for the scheduled run.

water.name: Water
water.description: Water level for the scheduled run.

passes.name: Passes
passes.description: Passes for the scheduled run, 1 to 3.

ignore_dnd.name: Ignore Do Not Disturb
ignore_dnd.description: Save the change even if the start time is inside the robot's Do Not Disturb window, where the robot will not run it. By default the call is refused instead.

remove_schedule.name: Remove schedule
remove_schedule.description: Delete one schedule from the robot, or all of them.

schedule_id.name: Schedule id
schedule_id.description: The robot's id for the schedule, e.g. S1.

all.name: All
all.description: Remove every schedule instead of one.

remove_matter_fabric.name: Remove Matter fabric
remove_matter_fabric.description: Unpair the robot from one Matter ecosystem. The fabric index and label are attributes of the Matter sensor. Untested on hardware (the author's robot is not paired to anything); it sends the app's removeBindFabric call.

fabric_index.name: Fabric index
fabric_index.description: fabric_index of the ecosystem to remove, from the Matter sensor.

local_api_unreachable.title: {name} has stopped answering locally
local_api_unreachable.description: Home Assistant could reach {name} at {host} before, but every poll has failed for the last 10 minutes. If nothing changed on your network, this is most likely the known Tapo firmware regression that breaks local access until the robot is power-cycled. Reboot the vacuum (hold the power button), and consider turning off automatic firmware updates in the Tapo app. This issue clears itself when polling works again.

data.show_panel: Show the Tapo Vacuum page in the sidebar

data_description.show_panel: The sidebar page has the full map, a schedules editor, history and statistics, maintenance and settings. Turn it off if you only want the card and entities.
